raw_text: WHO confirms Covishield (AstraZeneca-Oxford platform) remains on its Emergency Use Listing with an acceptable safety profile. The organisation noted that recent social media claims about elevated adverse event rates are based on retracted or non-peer-reviewed studies. WHO urged countries to rely on validated pharmacovigilance data rather than unverified social media reports when making vaccine procurement decisions.
clean_text: WHO confirmed Covishield remains on Emergency Use Listing with acceptable safety, stating social media claims about adverse events are based on retracted studies. Urged reliance on validated pharmacovigilance data.
